Below is a quick‑reference list of the **federal Canadian holidays that create long weekends in 2023**.  
(If you need province‑specific holidays—e.g., Family Day in Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc.—just let me know and I can add those too.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Weekend Days Covered | Notes |
|---------|-------------|----------------------|-------|
| New Year’s Day | **Sunday, Jan 1** | Sat Dec 31 2022 – Sun Jan 1 2023 | Long weekend because the holiday falls on a Sunday. |
| Good Friday | **Friday, Apr 7** | Fri Apr 7 – Sun Apr 9 | Friday + weekend. |
| Victoria Day | **Monday, May 22** | Mon May 22 – Sun May 28 | First Monday before May 25. |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc.) | **Monday, Feb 20** | Mon Feb 20 – Sun Feb 26 | Only in certain provinces. |
| Labour Day | **Monday, Sep 4** | Mon Sep 4 – Sun Sep 10 | First Monday in September. |
| Thanksgiving | **Monday, Oct 9** | Mon Oct 9 – Sun Oct 15 | Second Monday in October. |
| Christmas | **Monday, Dec 25** | Mon Dec 25 – Sun Dec 31 | Monday + weekend. |

**Holidays that do NOT create a long weekend in 2023**

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Reason |
|---------|-------------|--------|
| Canada Day | Saturday, Jul 1 | Falls on a Saturday – no extra day off. |
| Remembrance Day | Wednesday, Nov 11 | Mid‑week. |
| Boxing Day | Tuesday, Dec 26 | Tuesday – no weekend. |

---
